bounded_search.negative_finding_scope: No per-variant coefficient rationale was found in the inspected local primary/ISAE sections, literal tables, post-processing script/backup or command scripts. This is not a claim that no explanation exists elsewhere.

conclusion.documented_origin: The ISAE Part 4 report explicitly attributes section polar/control derivatives to XFOIL over its Reynolds-number range. It is a documented numerical derivation, not a measured 2D physical calibration.
conclusion.literal_mismatch: No one literal aileron model contains the complete reported pair. 20O contains the reported lift coefficient but a different moment coefficient; 40O contains the reported moment coefficient but a different lift coefficient; 60O/80O/95O contain neither member of the reported pair.
conclusion.not_inferred: The approximate reported 16%/5% Reynolds variation does not uniquely identify the Reynolds state or intended derivative pair for each literal file. No inference that any particular coefficient is a typo, measured calibration, or correct replacement is supported here.
conclusion.reported_method: Section 3.3, PDF page 13: stock ASWING 5.96 uses constant values from the highest Reynolds number; ASWING-m instead interpolates a two-point Reynolds lookup locally, with lower-end clipping. The report describes about 16% lift-derivative and 5% moment-derivative variation.
conclusion.safe_interpretation: Retain every literal coefficient in the current comparison. Treat the report/file mismatch as an unresolved input-provenance limitation, separate from solver accuracy and primary measured whole-wing response.
conclusion.special_20_percent_rationale: The inspected sources do not explain why only the 20% variant uses .0581 while the other four use .0686, or why only 40% uses -.0107. The numerical constants are traceable to the literal archive choices, but the per-variant assignment is not documented as a physical calibration.

primary_measurements_and_theory.locked_measurement: The wings were held horizontally; rolling moments at finite plus/minus aileron deflections were averaged. Figure 18 presents whole-wing rolling-moment coefficient Cl/delta per degree. These measured finite ratios are not an independently measured sectional cl_delta or cm_delta table, and are not automatically infinitesimal derivatives.
primary_measurements_and_theory.marker_identity: Figure 18 geometric markers are measured straight-wing results for the five spans. Crosses labeled Pearson (reference 4) and dashed curves labeled Cole (reference 2) are theoretical predictions. They must not be reclassified as measurements or used to calibrate section derivatives without explicit authorization and justification.
primary_measurements_and_theory.primary_theory_assumptions: The primary theoretical discussion uses common m0=5.66 per radian and (d alpha/d delta) at constant section normal coefficient = −0.64. It does not specify the later archived .0581/.0686 and −.0102/−.0107 per-variant assignments.
primary_measurements_and_theory.source: NACA TN 2563, PDF pages 9, 12–13 and Figure 18 on PDF page 38 (printed pages 8, 11–12 and 37).
primary_measurements_and_theory.stiffness_adjustment_distinction: The primary report says theoretical EI/GJ curves were adjusted to measured static deflections. That statement concerns structural stiffness and is not evidence that the later section control slopes were experimentally calibrated.

control_provenance.scope: Pinned AE-3 local files, primary NACA TN 2563, and the pinned ISAE Part 4 report. Bounded source audit; no external search, new physics calculation, coefficient fitting, or alternate-model run.

post_analysis.description: A commented block reads XFOIL alpha-zero and moment files at two Reynolds numbers, uses dF=−14:1:14, and contains polyfit operations. No mapping from these calculations to the six literal model multiplier lines is supplied. The block was not executed or repaired.
post_analysis.locked_curves: Later active arrays separately hard-code ASWING and ASWING-modified whole-wing curves. These arrays are predictions, not measured section polars, and do not explain why the literal coefficient pairs differ.
post_analysis.uncertainties: Archived polar files do not carry a flap-angle column, and the shell scripts do not provide per-row convergence provenance. The moment script includes hinge locations 0.7 and 0.75. Consequently exact derivative extraction and span-variant assignment cannot be certified merely from these filenames.
